clips.caption:
The Buddha said pain in life is inevitable. Suffering is optional.

Kevin Trudeau's examples: kids begging to go to the haunted house, people screaming and laughing at the same time on a roller coaster.

None of that is suffering. It's pain you're choosing to feel, as a witness to your own life instead of a victim of it.

You can feel everything fully - fear, loss, heartbreak - and still never suffer.

Where in your life are you suffering by choice, not by force?
